purpose: Freeze a candidate and its fit provenance before admitting genuinely future hand histories, keep the prospective ledger append-only and uncontaminated, close evaluation under precommitted metrics/thresholds, then explicitly release those hands only to a later TRAIN cycle.

precommit_identity.interpretation: Candidate, fit dataset identity, models, strategy, metrics, thresholds and temporal boundary are immutable for one holdout generation before any prospective HH is admitted.

hand_provenance.admission_rule: observed_at and first_seen_at are on/after admission_not_before_utc; novelty proof binds both to the frozen prior-hand universe and to the frozen candidate-fit hand-ID fingerprint.
hand_provenance.append_only_rule: Hands may be appended only while state=UNCONSUMED. Existing rows are immutable. On RELEASED_TO_FUTURE_TRAIN the sole permitted row mutation is train_eligible false->true.

evaluation.start_rule: UNCONSUMED -> EVALUATING freezes the hand ledger; evaluation.started_at must be on/after every admitted first_seen_at.
evaluation.rule: CLOSED persists one content-addressed report that distinguishes population drift, context/model coverage, and performance under the precommitted metrics and thresholds.

training_transition.rule: Prospective hands are never eligible for the fit of the candidate they evaluated. After closure they may be released only to a separately identified future TRAIN cycle.

scope.notes: This contract creates no real holdout generation, admits no real HH, consumes no existing VALIDATION/TEST data, and does not modify #107/#108 contracts, workflows or ledgers.
